title: I need a Slot Machine Minigame script

posts.author: EzBound
posts.body:
Hi! I'm producing a parody game of the Mario & Luigi series, and there's this part where they stay in a casino/hotel, this area is inspired by the Last Resort from OMORI, and kind of like the area I'm taking inspiration from, there will be a slot machine. I would need a script that creates a Slot Machine similar to the one in OMORI, with spinning symbols, background music and sound effects.
Here's an example of what i mean for those who haven't played OMORI.
